text:
tess-partners: Quick alignment thread — goal: produce marketplace-ready package for AWS/GCP/Azure by next Friday. Main items: SKUs/pricing, AMI/container/ARM artifacts, legal checklist, and a short procurement note. Assign owners?

liam-aws: I can handle AWS-specific bits (AMI manifest, product code). Need logo + support contact + billing example.

nina-legal: I'll compile the legal bundle (DPA, SOC2 summary, export controls). Please add a column in the SKU sheet for data residency and BAA requirement.

aaron-prod: I'll own SKU mapping and base pricing tiers. Plan: canonical SKU + variant suffixes for hosted/dedicated/enterprise. Will post CSV template today.

julia-design: I'll produce listing screenshots and a compact architecture card that fits marketplace constraints. Tell me which regions to show for AMI.

devops-bot: Packaging checklist created: /tasks/MP-910. CI will build marketplace tags nightly and push container + AMI builds to staging.

finance-team: For reserved offers we need forecast bands (S/M/L) with monthly committed tokens and example invoice splits. aaron — can you add those?

tess-partners: Owners recap: SKUs/pricing = aaron-prod; legal = nina-legal; AWS AMI = liam-aws; containers/ARM = devops (cc: jake); design = julia-design; finance inputs = finance-team. Deliverables by Fri: CSV, legal checklist PDF, artifact list (AMI IDs/container tags/ARM urls), two screenshots, procurement.md

liam-aws: minor blocker — license scan found an ambiguous OSS license in infra-agent. if it persists we'll need legal approval before AMI publication. nina, can you advise on impact?

nina-legal: I'll review the scan results. if we need an exception it'll add ~1 week; otherwise we can proceed. Please post the scan link.

aaron-prod: CSV template posted: `sku,variant,price_tier,commit_required,data_processing_location,requires_baa,support_sla,procurement_notes,notes`

julia-design: uploading first PNGs to shared drive in an hour.

devops-bot: AMI tags will follow pattern `redwood-marketplace-ami-YYYYMMDD-region`. container tags: `registry.redwood/release:marketplace-v1`

tess-partners: thanks all — i'll schedule a 30min review on Thursday 4pm and a final sign-off slot Friday 2pm. reopen thread if blockers surface.
